card.text: The Eagle Nebula is a star-forming H II region about 1,698 parsecs away.

sources.quote: The Eagle Nebula is a young open cluster of stars in the constellation of Serpens.

introduction.text: ESO's photograph of it stands here as a flat picture facing the Sun, 15.8 pc wide. The stars of its cluster, NGC 6611, are drawn as dots.
